name: timkeypro-video
description: Video skills for faceless creators and sellers: clone the edit style of any video into an editable CapCut draft, write natural Vietnamese sales scripts (TikTok Shop, Shopee Video, Facebook Reels), turn one video into posts for every platform, write and score 5-second hooks, and self-check videos against YouTube's inauthentic content rule and TikTok's AI label. Bắt chước phong cách edit, kịch bản bán hàng, một video nhiều nền tảng, hook 5 giây, kiểm tra chân thực.
